Foreign key to the history table (historyno_i). It links to the "Installation Label Booking" portion of Labelno 1, where Rotable 2 is installed (indicated by a "YE" entry in "Parts Tracking"). Labelno 1 is part of the whole "Swap" transaction.
Foreign key to the label table. It refers to the second label involved in the "Swap" transaction.

Foreign key to the history table (historyno_i). It links to the "Removal Label Booking" portion of Labelno 2, where Rotable 2 is removed (indicated by a "YA" entry in "Parts Tracking"). Labelno 2 is part of the whole "Swap" transaction.

Foreign key to the history table (historyno_i). It links to the "Release to Service" transaction of Rotable 1 (indicated by a "B1" entry in "Parts Tracking", stored in the history table) that occurs after the preceding Removal of Rotable 1. Note that this "Release to Service" entry for the "Swap" may be "NULL" as it is only recorded if the "Swap" was done between 2 Aircraft. A "Swap" of Rotables within one Aircraft will not trigger the recording of such a "B1 Release to Service" entry.

Foreign key to the history table (historyno_i). It links to the "Release to Service" transaction of Rotable 2 (indicated by a "B1" entry in "Parts Tracking", stored in the history table) that occurs after the preceding Removal of Rotable 2. Note that this "Release to Service" entry for the "Swap" may be "NULL" as it is only recorded if the "Swap" was done between 2 Aircraft.
